q: How do I calculate the carbon footprint of an alloy wheel?
title: Alloy wheel carbon footprint per wheel
short: Most of an alloy wheel is aluminium: multiply the cast weight, including gates and swarf, by the alloy supplier's figure. Add melting, low pressure casting, heat treatment, machining and painting energy, then divide by wheels passed.

ul: Low pressure die casting and heat treatment.

p: Report per wheel by size and finished weight. Recycled alloy lowers the figure.

example.title: Worked example: alloy wheel unit per wheel (one month)
lines: Plant total: 209,000 / 30,000 = 6.967 kg CO2 per wheel
Add aluminium alloy for the full figure
example.note: Inputs are illustrative; use your own bills and production records.

senseible: Senseible reads the plant's electricity bills (CEA grid factor 0.710 kg CO2 per kWh for FY 2024-25, CO2 Baseline Database version 21.0) and fuel invoices (IPCC 2006 defaults) into a fingerprinted Scope 1 and 2 record, the plant-level input to a per-unit figure. Bought-in materials go to the supplier evidence trail; product reports are self-declared drafts.
